name: com.cidonix.unibridge
description: Local MCP tools that let AI coding agents inspect, edit, capture, and validate Unity Editor projects through a per-project bridge and relay.

_upm.changelog:
### Fixed

- Windows named-pipe user SID is read directly from the Editor process TokenUser, without account-name lookup.
- Unicode SID conversion, checked token-query buffers and deterministic native resource cleanup.
- Existing user/System ACL and owner/System fallback preserved; relay remains 1.1.0-build.21.

### Added

- Focused WindowsSidRegression native pipe/SID and cleanup tests.
